newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank gives terms of merger with Hypo-Bank.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank gives terms of merger with Hypo-Bank.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Thursday its offer to exchange one share in Allianz AG for six shares in Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG (Hypo-Bank) would run from August 4 to September 10.
The offer is being made by Vereinsbank's Hamburg-based unit Vereins- und West-Bank AG, Vereinsbank said in a mandatory statement.

Detailing the terms of its planned merger with fellow Bavarian bank Hypo-Bank, Vereinsbank said it would use up to 19.3 million Allianz shares from its portfolio -- equivalent to a stake of up to 8.4 percent in Allianz -- to acquire a stake of up to 45 percent in Hypo-Bank.
The stake in Hypo-Bank is the first step towards a full merger of the two banks first announced last week.
The fusion will create a new bank called Bayerische Hypo- und Vereinsbank AG (BHV) which will be Germany's second largest commercial bank.
"This stake is the first step for the agreed merger of the banks," Vereinsbank said.
It added that there were conditions for the acceptance of the offer. The transaction has yet to be approved by the Federal Cartel Office and at least 40 percent of Hypo-Bank shares must be offered.
If more than 45 percent are offered, the allocation will be made on a pro-rata basis, Vereinsbank said.
Shareholders will in any case receive a full allocation of Allianz shares for the first 120 Hypo-Bank shares they offer, Vereinsbank said.
Hypo-Bank shareholders will not have to pay commission for the exchange.
After the swap, Vereinsbank will raise capital by a nominal 150 million marks to boost the new bank's equity base.
Preparation for the merger will begin in October and terms for the linkup will be based on 1997 final results. The deal will be presented to shareholders for approval by spring 1998.
A spokesman for Vereinsbank said the Vereins- und West-bank was acting as a "collection point" for the Hypo-Bank shares and that it was dealing with the technical aspects of settlement.
